# Browser PDF dependencies

Loaded only when independent PDF download is requested. Copied unchanged from pinned npm distributions; tests compare bytes against package-lock installs.

- html2canvas 1.4.1 https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
  SHA256: e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb
- jsPDF 4.2.1 https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
  SHA256: e6551fcdc32f09d6853b2c5126d18d01d9447e0da618a41a11ebeee0f6c20d54

MIT license copies are retained beside the scripts. No runtime third-party PDF service receives course content.
